about: Recorded ambience beds for tools/lyria_sfx.js --kind amb. id = the procedural bed of R.Audio.ambience (core/audio.js, "ambience" section) or a flag variant of one (bed = the spec it stands for: forest_night / breeze_night = {night:1} (crickets instead of birds), rain_surf = {bed:"rain", surf}). tomb = the cave without drips, ship = the muffled sea below deck, wind = the desert wind of clear desert maps. prompts: "A dry foley recording, not music: …" — the field-recording / nature-documentary wordings drifted into piano or electronic music almost every time (2026-10-04). lufs: the integrated loudness the file is normalised to — the level of the procedural bed at strength 1 / volume 10 (measured there: about -33.5 blizzard … -45 forest at night LUFS), so a file plays at unity gain on the amb bus.
